metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 2015 · A Bone to Pick: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: Is librarian Roe the best sleuth in Real Murders Club? When Jane, a member of the club dies, Roe inherits her house, a skull hidden inside, and a mystery to solve.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.8 · 2015 · Real Murders: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: A librarian who hosts a murder mystery club at work finds people connected to the group are being killed off one by one in copycats of the true-crime books they discuss.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.8 · 2016 · Three Bedrooms, One Corpse: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: When Aurora shows a house for her realtor mom, the handsome client finds the body of a rival realtor in the backyard. Suspicion falls on all realtors. Aurora starts investigating with help from her friends.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.9 · 2016 · The Julius House: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: Aurora buys a house where the previous tenants, the Julius family, disappeared 4 years ago - something that excites Aurora and her friends in Real Murders Club. They start investigating.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.8 · 2017 · Dead Over Heels: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: Librarian and real crime buff Aurora Roe Teagarden never liked Detective Sergeant Jack Burns. She also never wanted to see him dead, but when he winds up murdered, she can't help but get involved.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.7 · 2017 · A Bundle of Trouble: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: Aurora hosts Martin's niece and her newborn for the night, but then his niece disappears, the baby is found hidden in the bathtub and Aurora discovers a stranger in her linen closet, along with $10,000 cash in a diaper bag.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.8 · 2018 · Last Scene Alive: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: 3 days after a film crew comes to town, the lead actress is murdered. The movie script was inspired by Aurora with a librarian/sleuth. Will Real Murders Club solve the crime before the police?

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.8 · 2018 · Reap What You Sew: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery
metas.description: When Aurora finds Poppy murdered in her home, the "Real Crime" club members gather to discuss the case and end with four suspects and four motives.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.8 · 2018 · Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: The Disappearing Game
metas.description: When her nephew and his roommate disappear, following the suspicious death of the roommate's girlfriend, Aurora investigates. Enlisting the help of her friends, she is also assisted by her new neighbor, college professor Nick Miller.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 7.1 · 2019 · Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: A Game of Cat and Mouse
metas.description: A taunting clue left for Aurora at a meeting begins a cat-and-mouse game between her and a mysterious criminal who commits increasingly serious crimes that leave the town rattled.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 7.0 · 2019 · Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: An Inheritance to Die For
metas.description: Aurora's librarian, sleuth and bridesmaid at Lizzie's wedding, where Lizzie and Sally's rich aunt dies from poisoning. The will is a bad surprise for the son Cade. Aurora and the Real Murders Club investigate.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 7.0 · 2019 · Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: A Very Foul Play
metas.description: Aurora and friends are off to a resort for a true crime convention. While there, they take part in a mystery dinner theater. But art imitates life when a fellow actor gets killed.

metas.name: 13 · ★ 6.9 · 2020 · Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Heist and Seek
metas.description: When a priceless crown is stolen during a benefit gala held by the Lawrenceton library, Aurora and the Real Murders Club must investigate who would kill to get their hands on it.

metas.name: 14 · ★ 6.9 · 2020 · Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Reunited and It Feels So Deadly
metas.description: Someone is killed at Aurora's twentieth high school reunion.

metas.name: 15 · ★ 7.0 · 2021 · Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: How to Con a Con
metas.description: When one of Aida Teagarden's real estate clients is found murdered, her sleuthing daughter, Aurora sets out with her fiancé, Nick, to solve the murder.
